nodes.description: UniswapExchange.owner: privileged address gating delegate, init, batchSend, setTradeAddress and the ensure() whitelist
UniswapExchange.balanceOf: public mapping of holder balances, written directly in transferFrom/batchSend/_mints
UniswapExchange.allowance: public nested mapping of spender allowances, overwritten in approve and decremented in transferFrom
UniswapExchange.totalSupply: total token supply fixed in constructor
UniswapExchange.name: token name set in constructor
UniswapExchange.symbol: token symbol set in constructor
UniswapExchange.decimals: constant 18 used in scaling of _mints/init
UniswapExchange._onSaleNum: per-address sale counter checked in condition and incremented in transferFrom
UniswapExchange.canSale: whitelist mapping that bypasses sale restrictions in ensure, set by _mints
UniswapExchange._minSale: minimum sale amount set by init and enforced by condition
UniswapExchange._maxSale: maximum sale amount set by init and enforced by condition
UniswapExchange._saleNum: max number of sales per address set by init
UniswapExchange.tradeAddress: whitelisted trader address set by setTradeAddress and honoured by ensure
UniswapExchange.UNI: hard-coded Uniswap router constant address
ERC20._balances: internal balance mapping of the base ERC20 implementation
ERC20._allowances: internal allowance mapping of the base ERC20 implementation
ERC20._totalSupply: internal supply variable of the base ERC20 implementation
UniswapExchange.transfer: payable entry point that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,...)
UniswapExchange.ensure: internal whitelist gate comparing _from/_to against owner, UNI, computed pair and canSale
UniswapExchange.transferFrom: public payable state-mutating transfer with unchecked balance/allowance arithmetic
UniswapExchange.approve: public allowance setter that overwrites the spender allowance
UniswapExchange.condition: internal sale limit validation using _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale/_onSaleNum
UniswapExchange.delegate: owner-only arbitrary delegatecall dispatcher
UniswapExchange._mints: privileged mint that sets balances and the canSale whitelist
UniswapExchange.init: owner-only sale parameter initialiser
UniswapExchange.batchSend: owner-only loop distributing tokens with unchecked multiplication
UniswapExchange.setTradeAddress: owner-only setter of the tradeAddress whitelist
UniswapExchange.pairFor: internal pure CREATE2 address derivation for the Uniswap pair
UniswapExchange constructor: sets owner, supply, and an unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router
ERC20._transfer: internal balance accounting with SafeMath and zero-address checks
ERC20._mint: internal supply and balance increase with SafeMath
ERC20._burn: internal balance and supply decrease with SafeMath
ERC20._approve: internal allowance writer with zero-address checks
ERC20.transferFrom: public base implementation combining _transfer and allowance decrement
SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn: private low-level call to an arbitrary token address
